messages:
noah_csm: FYI RegionalPayments renewal in 33 days. Usage concentrated on batch jobs, their peak spikes are fine but daily active calls are ~15% of expected. They flagged billing surprise for compute in last invoice. Need a short save play + downgrade-then-winback option.

talia_successops: On it. Do we know if they use realtime endpoints?

noah_csm: Only for settlement windows, everything else is async batch. Their team said realtime is "expensive and unnecessary".

kevin_eng: We saw large variance in seq_len distribution. Could trim token max per request. Also they aren't using KV cache currently. Both are quick wins.

ashley_onboarding: They never got the billed-usage report walk-through. I can run a 20-min billing + telemetry session to show hotspots.

retention_bot: RiskScore=6/10  Signals: uneven_usage, invoice_spike, support_threads=2  SuggestedAction=telemetry-walkthrough + config-savings + timebound-discount

olivia_pm: Product note: We can offer a temporary "capped burst" plan: keep peak SLA but limit baseline billable throughput. Good for customers worried about cost while retaining reliability. Legal ok?

ops_bot: Policy check: capped-burst requires finance sign-off for revenue recognition. Typical approval time 48h.

talia_successops: Draft micro-play: 1) 24h: Billing walkthrough (ashley) 2) 48h: Config tuning + pref cache (kevin) 3) 72h: Offer capped-burst 2mo trial OR 15% credit on last invoice if they commit to 3-month plan 4) 10 days: follow-up usage report + renewal ask.

noah_csm: Love the options. Prefer the capped-burst trial as primary, credit as fallback. Add measurable promise: "reduce projected monthly spend by >=18% without loss of peak throughput".

kevin_eng: Implementation notes: KV cache + token cap change can be staged via feature-flag. I'll script the rollout and a quick perf baseline. Should be ready in 36h.

ashley_onboarding: I'll prepare billing explainer and sample invoice highlights. Need client approval for screen-share; offering two slots Tue 9am or Thu 4pm.

olivia_pm: I'll prep the capped-burst terms and a short customer-facing one-pager. Keep it explicit: duration = 60 days, auto-revert unless renewed.

retention_bot: Action created: play/1823459999_regpay_saveplay  Due=1823546399 (9 days)  Owner=talia_successops

talia_successops: Assignments: @ashley_onboarding run billing session in 48h, @kevin_eng prepare config patch and rollout plan, @olivia_pm draft offer doc, @noah_csm lead exec check-in. I'll draft outreach and tag finance.

noah_csm: Outreach sent — exec check-in scheduled for Thu 4pm. Pasted email: "Hi Alex  we noticed billing spike and lower DAU than expected. Quick 20-min session to show savings + a 60-day capped-burst option. Thu 4pm OK?"

kevin_eng: Pushing config PR to staging now. Will post perf delta in 6h.

noah_csm: Great. We'll aim to convert to a 3-month committed plan after the trial. Leaving thread open for updates. :thumbsup:
